texts.6dbaf052ac54: The Endo-Vascular Aneurysm Repair (EVAR) trials have been implemented to assess the efficiency of EVAR in the treatment of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm(AAA). Two trials have been set up, EVAR1 compares EVAR with Open Repair (OR) in patients considered fit for both procedures and EVAR2 compares EVAR plus best medical treatment alone in patients considered unfit for open repair.
texts.f0c067b2b1df: The data supplied by the NHS IC to Charring Cross Hospital will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project identified above.
